# Incident Response Playbook

## 1. Scope

Use this runbook when service latency and error rate spike at the same time.

## 2. Timeline Reconstruction

| phase | owner | sla |
| --- | --- | --- |
| detect | oncall | 5m |
| classify | incident commander | 10m |
| verify | sre | 15m |

```sql
select ts, p95_latency_ms, error_rate
from metrics_incident
where service = 'api-gateway'
order by ts desc
limit 100;
```
